items.name: Agent Gallery
items.fitReason: Panel-to-screen layout for a future Control / Verify / Review / Alerts section.

items.name: Approval Card
items.carteRole: Pro option for step 04 — not used
items.fitReason: Risk badge + approve / deny fits, but Pro source cannot ship in this public repo.
items.limitations: preview inspected; source unavailable — fallback: Decision Inbox (free).

items.name: Button
items.carteRole: reference for action buttons (Reset demo, Run check) — styles adapted into security.module.css
items.fitReason: Same primary / secondary / ghost hierarchy as the other Affect UI parts.
items.limitations: Not imported: a 12 KB component for two buttons; its sizes / radii are mirrored in CSS.

items.name: Change Summary
items.carteRole: phone cover screen + process column — remote overview of card / alert status
items.fitReason: One metric per row with a toned trend: fits a remote status panel.
items.limitations: Rows are demo state (frozen / active, open reviews, alerts), never invented business metrics.

items.name: Decision Inbox
items.carteRole: bento payment + phone step 04 — Review before you approve (Recognize / Freeze demo card)
items.fitReason: Two quick answers per decision, confirm then fold away — exactly a payment review.
items.limitations: Forked: one fixed demo transaction, two different outcomes (approved vs card frozen), Reset demo, state from the shared model so the phone matches.

items.name: Integration Settings
items.limitations: preview inspected; source unavailable; would imply a real connected bank.

items.name: Notification Stack
items.carteRole: bento invested + phone step 06 — Alerts that matter
items.fitReason: Only the front notice is readable; dismiss reveals the next.
items.limitations: Used through props; the adapter moves focus to the next notice / Reset and remounts on reset.

items.name: OTP Input
items.carteRole: reference for the verification sandbox — not shipped (no code entry needed: the check is simulated)
items.fitReason: Documents verified / error states the Carte copy mirrors.
items.limitations: Not imported; six code boxes do not fit a 168 px tile and we never ask for a real code.

items.name: Progress Tracker
items.carteRole: phone section — six-checkpoint progress in the process column
items.fitReason: Bar + ticks that draw themselves; reads as a checklist of the demo.
items.limitations: Rebuilt as a controlled tracker (the source owns its own ticks); look and motion mirrored.

items.name: Segmented Control
items.carteRole: bento credit — Freeze in a tap (Active / Frozen switch for the demo card)
items.fitReason: Binary state with a gliding indicator, radiogroup semantics, arrow / Home / End keys and drag already designed.
items.limitations: Used as-is through props; the frozen state itself lives in the shared demo model.

items.name: Thinking Loader
items.carteRole: bento easy + phone step 05 — Verify the moment (Checking → Verified, simulated)
items.fitReason: Phase labels roll through and settle on a drawn check; reduced-motion aware.
items.limitations: Driven with controlled `done` and custom phases / done label.

items.name: Tool Call Card
items.carteRole: reference for the signals disclosure (step 03/04 detail rows)
items.fitReason: Fold-open details with status pill — mirrored for the signal rows.
items.limitations: Not imported (AI tool arguments / results do not apply); disclosure pattern reimplemented.

items.name: Enrichment Orbit
items.carteRole: bento ai — Signals in focus (device, amount, location orbiting the Carte shield)
items.fitReason: Small SVG illustration with two counter-rotating comets; nodes stay upright.
items.limitations: Forked: Grok mark replaced by a shield, nodes get Device / Amount / Location glyphs, animation pauses off-screen. Illustration only — no claim of a live fraud model.

items.name: Integration Beam
items.carteRole: bento customers — A safer route for every payment (Card · Device · Merchant → Carte → Checks · Approval · Receipt)
items.fitReason: Measured beams, sequenced pulses, hover focus, click to pause with live status — explains a payment route without fake partner logos.
items.limitations: Used through props with Carte glyphs; no third-party logos. Font / spacing overridden from the adapter scope.

items.name: Layer Stack
items.carteRole: bento trust — Protection, in layers (five checkpoints around a payment)
items.fitReason: Five selectable layers, auto-cycle that stops after user input, hover/focus pause, ↑/↓ keys.
items.limitations: Forked: Carte icons (the source only ships bolt/database/plug/spark/pulse), controlled index for the shared model, compact list-under-stack layout for the 358 px column.

items.name: Number Ticker
items.carteRole: amount roll-in on the review panel ($32.10 demo charge)
items.fitReason: Odometer digits for the single demo amount.
items.limitations: Only the demo fixture amount is animated.

items.name: Settings & Billing
items.fitReason: Security-control dashboard layout reference for a later route.
items.limitations: preview inspected; source unavailable; billing content out of scope.
